subject: Rosaria Mazza

subject: Venerio Mazza
note: Read in full. Witness Mazza Antonino, 35. Married Greco Rosaria di Carmelo, 16 Nov 1908.

subject: Gaetano Mazza
note: Read in full. Witnesses Dimauro Salvatore 22 and Zappalà Sebastiano 24, both braccianti.

subject: Salvatore Mazza & Concetta Sciacca
note: Read in full. THE KEY ACT. Salvatore, 34, bracciante, born and resident Piedimonte Etneo, son of Innocenzio and of Domenica Cavallaro — the father's name written in the contracted form «Senzio». Concetta Sciacca, 19, contadina, daughter of the late Antonino Sciacca and Rosaria Greco.

subject: Antonino Mazza & Rosa Raiti
note: Read in full. Antonino Mazza, 31, bracciante, born and resident Piedimonte Etneo, «figlio d'Innocenzio, bracciante, e di Domenica Cavallaro, industriosa». Rosa Raiti, 20, industriosa, daughter of Giuseppe Raiti, bracciante, and Agata Pennisi. Witnesses Angelo Russo fu Venero, 40, and Felice Russo fu Angelo, 60. THIS IS THE ACT THAT SPELLS THE FATHER'S NAME IN FULL and makes Salvatore and Antonino brothers.
